$comment: Dinis's five steps of the agentic workflow against what the record shows for the storm (S41), at 17:22 UTC on 10 November 2026. Copied from the trace's workflow_against_the_brief, with the times of each step's evidence. Made by journalist.newsroom@PrompTugal.dinis.
finding: Steps 2 to 4 collapsed into the agent that needed them. What slowed the work was a grant (52 min), a gate (12 min) and a security review (stop-gap in 8 min), never a missing tool. The weak signal (the mayor, 13:23) came 5 h 46 min before the organisers' post and was missed: the desk watched primary sources only, and the press watch started at 18:46.

1_raw_source.evidence: IPMA's warnings, forecast and observation feeds are JSON; the weather desk read five IPMA feeds plus transport feeds (Carris Metropolitana alerts JSON, Transtejo RSS)

2_request_for_a_parser.status: skipped: the desk built its own
2_request_for_a_parser.evidence: no request to a conductor or developer for a parser; weather@ wrote tools/watch.mjs itself (eight sources) at the guidance's word. The only request for help is still for a person (lisboa.pt, ANA, CP). The first request to a developer came from the gate (step 50: links without target=_blank), fixed in 12 minutes (step 52).

3_architect_plan.status: a proposal in place of a plan
3_architect_plan.evidence: desks/weather-vicky/proposal-storm-page.md, for the page; no architect agent

4_developer_and_designer.status: storm page built and verified twice, cleared by Vicky to publish after the last check
4_developer_and_designer.evidence: a verify-and-fix loop between reviewer@ and dev@PrompTugal.vicky: check 23:47, fix 23:55, check 00:00, fix 00:09

5_ui_signal.status: done: the lead, the satellite loop and /storm/charles/ are live
